name: Private updates with license keys
query: We sell a pro plugin from our own site. Add license key activation and automatic updates from our server.
expected_behavior: Step 2: Add an Update URI header and hook update_plugins_{$hostname} for that host
Step 3: Fetch, validate and cache the update JSON; only accept https packages on the update host
Step 4: Send the license key in a header only to the update host via http_request_args
Step 5: Add plugins_api for the View details modal with wp_kses_post sections
Step 6: Fail safe: license problems disable updates, never site functionality
success_criteria: No remote kill switch or obfuscation
License key never in URLs or autoloaded options
Update server outages do not slow every admin page (negative caching)
Disclosure of data sent in readme/privacy text
